boundary: No transaction: PreviewResourceServlet.doGet resolves the weblog (WeblogRequest.getWeblog) and, only if the resource is not found in the preview theme or the weblog's theme, falls back to JPAMediaFileManagerImpl.getMediaFileByOriginalPath (PreviewResourceServlet.java:99-100); every read goes through JPAPersistenceStrategy.getEntityManager(false), no transaction opens, each read auto-commits. The file bytes themselves come from FileContentManagerImpl (filesystem), not the database.
